lines.speaker: S1
lines.english: Good morning! Fresh apples, picked at dawn. Two coins a basket.
lines.text: Prait lér! Clanreuque cécassi, lauvimete ké maumu. Daume vratri za guiangésse.

lines.speaker: S2
lines.english: Two coins? They look a little bruised to me.
lines.text: Daume vratrisi? Kon cheau za blait bradanchin vé pè.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.english: Bruised? Those are freckles. Apples have freckles too.
lines.text: Pranségete? Meu jé douron. Cécassi mio nazbransi flait.

lines.speaker: S2
lines.english: Then the freckles cost one coin, and the apples another.
lines.text: Lia za nazbransi rafeve rausse vratri, zi za cécassi diait.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.english: Ah, you are a hard woman. One and a half, and I add a pear.
lines.text: Ah, bé jé za vaplou réque. Rausse zi za aijon, zi pè rissou za zaru.

lines.speaker: S2
lines.english: One coin and the pear, and I come back tomorrow.
lines.text: Rausse vratri zi za zaru, zi pè preau quait piait.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.english: Every day you come back, and every day I lose money. Fine. One coin.
lines.text: Miait creur bé preau quait, zi miait creur pè nér vouque. Frait. Rausse vratri.

lines.speaker: S2
lines.english: You never lose money. Thank you, old friend.
lines.text: Bé zou zér nér teu vouque. Mérsil bé, bleune lanziait.
